title: Vice President, Technical Writer
description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Product Owner to join our Data Solutions & Services team. This role is located in PUNE.

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Own the creation and maintenance of clear, accurate, and user-focused technical documentation for data management, governance, platform, and product capabilities, including user guides, operating procedures, process documentation, release notes, FAQs, and training materials.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Governance, and business stakeholders to understand complex capabilities and translate them into structured, easy-to-consume documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive the documentation lifecycle from requirements discovery and drafting through review, approval, publication, version control, and ongoing maintenance as products and processes evolve.
* Define and maintain documentation standards, templates, terminology, and information architecture across products to improve consistency, usability, discoverability, and adoption.
* Support product launches, adoption, and change-management activities through release communications, onboarding content, process walkthroughs, training material, and self-service knowledge assets.
* Document end-to-end product workflows, roles, decision points, system interactions, APIs, data flows, metadata, lineage, data quality, controls, and regulatory requirements in partnership with subject matter experts.
* Use user feedback, support trends, and adoption signals to continuously improve product documentation and identify opportunities for stronger self-service and user experience.
* Apply AI-assisted authoring and knowledge-management techniques, with appropriate human review and governance, to improve documentation speed, consistency, and reuse.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Product Management, Technical Communication, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, English, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Technical Writer, or similar role, with strong hands-on responsibility for documenting enterprise software, data platforms, governance processes, or other complex technology capabilities.
* Strong ability to understand APIs, data flows, system interactions, metadata, lineage, data quality, controls, and workflow concepts well enough to translate them into accurate product and user documentation.
* Excellent written communication, editing, and information-structuring skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical and business concepts without losing accuracy.
* Experience working with Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, or Governance stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment, with the ability to gather requirements and drive documentation through review and sign-off.
* Working knowledge of documentation and collaboration tools such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Confluence, Jira, Miro, or similar platforms; familiarity with structured authoring, docs-as-code, or knowledge-management approaches is a plus.
* Comfort working in an evolving product environment, managing multiple documentation streams, and proactively identifying gaps or inconsistencies in requirements, processes, and user guidance.
* Experience with AI-enabled documentation, knowledge search, or content-generation tools is preferred, along with an understanding of validation, traceability, and controlled publishing in regulated environments.
* Strong stakeholder-management and product ownership skills, with the ability to drive reviews, resolve ambiguity, prioritize documentation needs, and obtain timely sign-off from subject matter experts.

title: Transfer Pricing Documentation Analyst
description:
**Transfer Pricing Documentation Analyst**  
  
**Location:** Pune  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years

**About the Role**

At Convera, we are seeking a Transfer Pricing Documentation Analyst who will report to the Head of International Tax & Transfer Pricing and support the company's global transfer pricing documentation, compliance, and operational transfer pricing activities.

The primary focus of this role is to support global transfer pricing compliance and governance by preparing and maintaining transfer pricing documentation, including Master Files, Local Files, and related analyses across multiple jurisdictions.

The role involves coordinating with external advisers to ensure appropriate benchmarking studies are in place, supporting the review and updating of intercompany agreements, and ensuring transfer pricing policies are implemented and properly documented across the business.

You will collaborate closely with the Head of International Tax & Transfer Pricing, the Global Tax team, finance teams, regional stakeholders, and external advisers.

This is an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in transfer pricing within a global financial services organisation while gaining broader exposure to international tax, operational transfer pricing, and tax forecasting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and maintain annual transfer pricing documentation across the Convera group, including Master Files, Local Files, and supporting documentation.

* Coordinate documentation requests from external advisers and local finance teams across multiple jurisdictions.

* Maintain a central repository of transfer pricing documentation, intercompany agreements, and supporting analyses.

* Monitor transfer pricing filing obligations and compliance deadlines across jurisdictions, maintaining compliance calendars and status reports.

* Work with external advisers to ensure relevant benchmarking studies are available to support the group's transfer pricing policies.

* Collaborate with finance teams to collect and validate information required for transfer pricing documentation and compliance projects.

* Support the review and updating of intercompany agreements to ensure alignment with current transfer pricing policies and business operations.

* Assist in responding to tax authority enquiries, audits, and information requests relating to transfer pricing matters.

* Support the implementation and monitoring of transfer pricing policies and operational transfer pricing processes.

* Assist with forecasting by gathering and analysing transfer pricing data to assess its expected impact on projected financial results.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Tax, or a related discipline, or a relevant professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CTA, or equivalent.

* 3–5 years of experience in transfer pricing.

* Hands-on experience supporting transfer pricing documentation and associated compliance activities.

* Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.

* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.

* Experience working with external advisers.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Experience in a multinational organisation, financial services business, or professional services firm.

* Exposure to OECD transfer pricing principles and documentation requirements.

* Experience supporting interactions with external advisers and tax authorities.

* Familiarity with Oracle, FCCS, EPM, or similar ERP and reporting systems.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Global transfer pricing documentation is completed accurately and on schedule.

* Compliance deadlines are proactively tracked and managed across jurisdictions.

* Requests from external advisers and tax authorities are handled efficiently.

* Intercompany agreements and supporting documentation remain current and well organised.

* Transfer pricing data is collected consistently and accurately across jurisdictions.

* Opportunities for process improvement and automation are identified and implemented.

**About Convera**

Convera is a leading non-bank B2B cross-border payments company, helping organisations move money smarter and more efficiently across the globe. With decades of expertise and innovative payment solutions, Convera serves a diverse range of customers, from small businesses to global institutions.

The company is committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative workplace that supports professional development and growth.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunities.

* Career development opportunities within a global organisation.

* Flexible working approach.

* Supportive and inclusive team environment.

**Interested in this opportunity?**

If you have relevant transfer pricing experience and are looking to grow your career in international tax within a global FinTech organisation, we would love to hear from you!

title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Technical Documentation
description:

-------------

The ideal candidate to translate practical field-service knowledge into clear, accurate and user-focused technical documentation while working effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

* Translate field-service practices, engineering information and product knowledge into **clear and executable service procedures**.
* Collect, evaluate and validate technical inputs including **3D models, BOMs, service data and product information**.
* Collaborate with **Product Engineering, Service, Product Management, Business Areas and external vendors** to resolve technical queries and ensure completeness of inputs.
* Develop strong knowledge of **vacuum products, service processes, configurations and field-service requirements**.

* Coordinate with customers and stakeholders to collect inputs, clarify requirements, provide status updates and incorporate feedback.
* Support **Product Database requests** and related Business Area activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve **documentation quality, processes, productivity and turnaround time**.
* Coordinate and control work delivered by **external agencies**, both onsite and offshore.
* Support unanticipated technical documentation requirements and project deliverables.
* Explore and apply **AI and automation** to improve existing documentation workflows and productivity.

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

**What we are looking for**

* **2-3 years of experience** in field service, service engineering, technical documentation or a related engineering function.
* Experience in the **vacuum business / vacuum equipment / industrial machinery** is highly desirable.
* Practical understanding of **field-service activities, maintenance procedures and troubleshooting**.
* Diploma/Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical qualification.
* Ability to understand **engineering drawings, BOMs, 3D models and technical specifications**.
* Strong technical writing, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining **quality and delivery commitments**.
* Experience with technical authoring tools, PLM/ERP or product databases is an advantage.
* Exposure to **AI, automation or digital documentation solutions** is an added advantage.

**In return, we offer**

* Ample of opportunities for professional development
* New challenges and opportunities to learn every day
* A culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behaviour, and integrity
* Drive your Career, Explore Opportunities, Realize your Passion.
* Together we build a culture where difference is valued, and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.
